edges.reason: AdminVault constructor initializes owner from msg.sender
changeOwner reverts unless msg.sender equals the stored admin
changeAdmin reverts unless msg.sender equals the stored admin
withdrawStuckFunds is gated by onlyOwner which compares adminVault.owner() to msg.sender
kill is gated by onlyAdmin checked against msg.sender
setOwner is protected by the auth modifier which authorizes msg.sender for msg.sig
DSProxyCache.write is public and unauthenticated, any msg.sender can deploy and cache bytecode
msg.sender is forwarded as the src argument of isAuthorized
selfdestruct beneficiary is msg.sender
authority.canCall is used for the fallback authorization decision in isAuthorized
isAuthorized return value gates execution of setOwner
startContractChange can only be called by the registry owner
approveContractChange can only be called by the registry owner
startWaitPeriodChange can only be called by the registry owner
approveWaitPeriodChange can only be called by the registry owner
block.timestamp is stored as changeStartTime to start the delay window
approval requires block.timestamp to be at least changeStartTime plus waitPeriod
block.timestamp records the start of a wait period change
wait period change approval depends on block.timestamp versus changeStartTime plus waitPeriod
addNewContract writes the Entry struct into entries mapping
startContractChange updates changeStartTime and inContractChange flags in entries
approveContractChange updates contractAddr in entries from pendingAddresses
previousAddresses[_id] is set to the old contract address for rollback
pendingAddresses[_id] is read and cleared during approval
pendingWaitTimes[_id] is read and cleared during wait period approval
adminVault.owner() is read to enforce the onlyOwner check
owner state value is compared against msg.sender in withdrawStuckFunds
raw _callData is ABI-decoded into the Params struct
executeAction receives the raw calldata buffer from the recipe executor
parseInputs is invoked at the start of executeAction
executeAction calls _mcdOpen with parsed join and manager addresses
executeActionDirect calls _mcdOpen directly
logger.logActionDirectEvent is invoked by executeActionDirect
_joinAddr parameter selects the ilk/join and thus the external call target
_mcdManager parameter selects which manager/registry external call is made
_mcdOpen performs IJoin(_joinAddr).ilk() external call
_mcdOpen performs an external open() call on a caller-chosen manager or registry
vaultId local captures the result of the open call and is encoded into logData
_token parameter decides the ERC20 branch versus native ETH branch
_to parameter becomes the recipient of the outgoing value transfer
_amount parameter decides the transferred quantity
withdrawTokens executes the low-level call{value} to _to
_to is the direct destination of the low-level ETH call
ETH_ADDR comparison selects the native ETH withdrawal path
the ETH recipient can re-enter executeAction while the value transfer is in progress
sendValue executes the low-level call{value} to the recipient
recipient parameter defines the value transfer target
amount parameter defines the value transferred
recipient is the call target of the low-level value call
_functionCallWithValue executes the arbitrary low-level call with value
functionCall delegates to _functionCallWithValue with zero value
safeTransfer delegates to _callOptionalReturn with encoded transfer calldata
the encoded token call is executed on the untrusted token contract
the token contract is external code that can execute callbacks during safeTransfer
_code parameter is deployed via create and hashed into the cache key
write executes assembly create on caller supplied bytecode
write stores the deployed address under keccak256(_code) in cache
read returns cache[keccak256(_code)]
kill executes selfdestruct sending the balance to msg.sender
withdrawStuckFunds transfers native ETH to the caller-supplied receiver
withdrawStuckFunds uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer for ERC20 withdrawals
normalizeDrawAmount performs checked fixed-point scaling (_amount * RAY) with rounding
getAllDebt computes art * rate - dai with precision/overflow sensitive arithmetic
toPositiveInt is used by normalizeDrawAmount to bound the signed normalized amount
_parseParamAddr uses getSubIndex to index the subscribed values array
_parseParamUint uses getReturnIndex to index the return values array

normalization_plan.reason: _to is the attacker-controlled destination of the low-level ETH call and should be collapsed into that unsafe operation
_amount is the value forwarded in the low-level ETH call and should be collapsed into that unsafe operation
_token only selects the branch inside withdrawTokens and has no meaning outside that function
_joinAddr controls the external ilk() call performed by _mcdOpen and should merge into that function
_mcdManager selects the external open() call inside _mcdOpen and should merge into that function
_callData is only meaningful as the input decoded by parseInputs
vaultId exists only as the return value of the open call inside _mcdOpen
_code is the bytecode deployed and hashed by write and has no role outside it
recipient is the direct target of the low-level value call and should merge into that unsafe operation
amount is the value passed to the low-level call and should merge into that unsafe operation
owner_ is only assigned to the owner state inside setOwner
_owner is only assigned to the owner state inside changeOwner
_admin is only assigned to the admin state inside changeAdmin
